facts.value: Unconditionally scales the supplied vector's x/y components by p_ftCommonData->x800, volatile-reads z without writing it, calls ftCommon_8007D5D4, then enters ftCo_MS_ItemScrewAir through ftCo_800CBAC4 with timer-reset argument 1. The setup marks GA_Air, sets jumpsUsed to 1 and locks the ECB for 10; the aerial helper starts the motion at frame 0/rate 1, sets x2221_b7, copies the complete vector into self_vel, sets the vertical-stick timer to 0xFE and increments jumpsUsed to 2. Thus the composed entry resets then increments the count rather than incrementing the previous count. It has no local input guard; the inspected aerial-jump caller checks jump input and held-item eligibility before invocation. ItemScrewAir_Anim enters FallAerial when animation frames are exhausted.
facts.rationale: Replace the ambiguous 'consumes one available jump' description with the exact cross-file write sequence and preserve the vector's volatile z access.
